questions.q: ------- the shipment arrived two days late, the customer still renewed the annual contract.
questions.why: 後ろに SV（節）が続くので接続詞が必要。Despite は前置詞、Nevertheless と Instead は副詞で、節をつなげない。

questions.q: All invoices must be submitted ------- the end of the month to be processed on time.
questions.why: 期限を表す「〜までに」は by。since は起点、during は期間の継続を表す。

questions.why: 後ろが名詞句（the heavy snowstorm）なので前置詞句の Because of。Because などは節を続ける接続詞。

questions.q: The panel discussion will focus ------- ways to reduce packaging waste.
questions.why: focus on 〜 で「〜に焦点を当てる」。

questions.q: Candidates ------- résumés are submitted after Friday will not be considered.
questions.why: 空所の後ろが名詞（résumés）で「その候補者の履歴書」という所有の関係なので whose。

questions.q: The conference room, ------- was renovated last spring, can now seat sixty people.
questions.why: 先行詞は物（The conference room）で、後ろに動詞が続くので主格の which。what は先行詞を取らない。

questions.q: The seminar is intended for employees ------- want to improve their presentation skills.
questions.why: 先行詞は人（employees）で、後ろに動詞 want が続くので主格の who。

questions.why: 否定の副詞句 Not only が文頭に来ると倒置になる。主語 the new bakery は三人称単数なので does。

questions.why: require that 〜 のあとの節では動詞は原形（仮定法現在）になる。

questions.why: 主語と同じ人を強調する再帰代名詞（強調用法）の herself。

questions.why: Each of + 複数名詞 は単数扱いなので動詞は is。

docs.label: Article
docs.text: GREENFIELD (June 3) — The Greenfield City Council voted 6-3 on Tuesday to approve a plan to add 12 kilometers of protected bike lanes to the city's central district over the next two years. The project, which will cost an estimated $4.2 million, will be funded mostly by a regional transportation grant, with the remainder coming from the city budget. Supporters, including Councilmember Rosa Tindall, argued that the lanes will reduce traffic and make streets safer for cyclists. Opponents raised concerns that removing parking spaces along Delmar Avenue could hurt small businesses. In response, the council agreed to hold a public meeting in September to review parking options before construction begins on that street. Work on the first section, along Market Street, is scheduled to begin in March.

Re: Flexible Hours Pilot Program

Starting October 1, the company will test a flexible-hours program for six months. Employees in the Accounting, Design, and Customer Support departments may begin work any time between 7 A.M. and 10 A.M., provided that they complete eight hours and are available for meetings during core hours, 10 A.M. to 3 P.M. Employees who wish to participate must obtain their supervisor's approval and submit the attached form to Human Resources by September 20. At the end of the pilot, a survey will be sent to participants, and management will decide whether to make the program permanent. Employees in the Warehouse Department are not eligible at this time because of shift-based staffing, but Human Resources is exploring alternatives for them.

Communications Coordinator — Seabright Marine Institute

Seabright Marine Institute, a nonprofit research organization in Port Halden, is seeking a full-time Communications Coordinator to manage its website, newsletter, and social media accounts. Responsibilities include writing news stories about research projects, coordinating photo and video shoots, and working with scientists to explain complex findings to the public.

Requirements: a bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, or a related field; at least two years of experience in a similar role; excellent writing skills. Experience with video editing is a plus but not required.

Salary: $48,000–$56,000, depending on experience. Benefits include health insurance and 20 vacation days.

To apply, send a résumé, a cover letter, and three writing samples to careers@seabright.example by November 30. Applicants who do not send writing samples will not be considered.
